_comment: THE NEGATIVE CONTROL FOR THE DRAWN EMIEL -- the same board, and no pip-free outlet to draw.
edf_co_27's board exactly (Mariposa as the ONLY {C}, Kitchen + Conservatory x2 with two
Overgrowths, Eldrazi Displacer as the outlet, Peregrine Drake as the payload, Essence Depleter
already in play, net +5 mana and net_c ZERO), the same 22-card library with the same live
{5},{T} / {4},{T} draws -- and NOT ONE Emiel the Blessed in it.
Every Session 24 lever is ON here, which is the whole point: the widening must find an outlet
that is REALLY reachable. With no pip-free blink outlet in hand or library,
PipFreeOutletFromHandLive is false, eff_net_c stays at the loop's own net_c of 0,
c_iterations refuses to price the drain's pips, Fundable's (mana, pips) pair cannot clear
(c_res <= c_yield: no untap schedule on this board makes a second colourless) -- and the
The EXECUTOR half is controlled here too: ComboOffNeedsDrawnOutlet requires a pip-free outlet
to be IN THE LIBRARY before it will keep the dig running past a reachable finisher, so on this
board `want_draw` goes false at iteration 0 exactly as it always did.
Without this control, edf_co_27 would pass equally well on a rule that had simply stopped
